title: Is there a way to make ledges prettier with the basic resources? [ RPG MAKER VX ACE ]

posts.author: israelbombocity
posts.body:
Hello! I've lurked around this forum for a few years now but this is finally my first post.
I wanted to make an area that gives the feel of being higher up than the others but still keep the grassy terrain of the ground, but no matter what I do I can't seem to make the ledges look good! Am I just being dumb or is there no way of solving this issue with regular RTP?
